scientific limitations/integrity: The result concerns compact invariant probability measures of the deterministic phase-extended published system. It proves exact stationary identities and strict mean controller dissipation under nonzero periodic forcing, but not existence or attraction of any particular recurrent orbit. General first-order-filter passivity is related background; the claim is restricted to the exact nonlinear identities for this cardiac model.
title: Exact stationary power laws for exponential-memory cardiac control
